name: Pine Cliffs Residence, Luxury Collection
insider_take: Perched dramatically on red sandstone cliffs 200 feet above the Atlantic, this isn't just another beach resort—it's Portugal's most spectacular clifftop sanctuary where luxury meets raw natural beauty.
whats_special: Pine Cliffs sits on some of Europe's most stunning coastline, featuring direct access to Praia da Falésia—consistently ranked among Portugal's top beaches. The resort's championship golf course, designed by Martin Hawtree, includes the famous Devil's Parlour hole that plays directly over a dramatic cliff ravine. The property also houses Portugal's largest thalassotherapy spa, utilizing mineral-rich seawater from the Atlantic.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the clifftop restaurant—the views of the golden cliffs meeting the azure Atlantic are absolutely magical, and you'll often spot dolphins playing in the waves below.
dont_miss: The resort's private beach elevator that descends through the cliff face to the golden sand beach below, and the nearby historic town of Tavira with its Roman bridge and camera obscura offering 360-degree views of the Ria Formosa Natural Park—one of Portugal's seven natural wonders.
pros: Spectacular clifftop location with panoramic Atlantic Ocean views
Spacious luxury residences with full kitchens and private terraces
Championship golf course designed by Martin Hawtree
Multiple pools including infinity pool overlooking the ocean
World-class spa and wellness facilities with ocean views
cons: Remote location requires transportation to nearby towns
